title: File exceeds 1000 lines (1715 lines total)
detail: instance.py is the largest object module in the batch at 1715 lines. It mixes DB-layer logic, versioning, lazy-load property management, and business operations in a single class. Suggested fix: consider splitting ORM/DB helpers into a separate db-layer module, leaving the object class focused on versioning and domain logic.

title: `create` has cyclomatic complexity 26 (threshold: 15)
detail: Lizard reports CCN=26 for `create` (97 NLOC). The method handles default population, flavor embedding, network allocation and DB write in a single body with deeply nested conditionals. Suggested fix: extract sub-operations (flavor embed, request spec transform, security group population) into private helpers called from `create`.
